exclusions.source_text: WHO performance status of ≤ 2 at screening
Creatinine clearance (CrCl) as estimated by Cockcroft-Gault equation of ≥ 50 ml/min
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤ 5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)
Total bilirubin ≤ 3 x ULN (unless gilbert's syndrome, then patients may be eligible if total serum bilirubin is ≤ 5.0 x ULN or direct bilirubin is ≤ 3 x ULN)
Non-pregnant, non-lactating females who are postmenopausal, surgically sterile
Has any history of glioma, a concurrent malignancy, or malignancy within 3 years of randomization, unless definitive therapy is completed
Known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection (Note: testing is not required).
Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding
Known active hepatitis B or C (Note: testing is not required).
